timeout-prefix: timeout 900 gcloud sql instances create ml-db --tier=db-f1-micro --region=us-central1
nohup-gcloud: nohup gcloud compute instances create nh-vm --zone us-central1-a &
brace: { gcloud compute instances create br-vm --zone us-central1-a; }
if-then: if ! gcloud compute instances describe it-vm --zone us-central1-a; then gcloud compute instances create it-vm --zone us-central1-a; fi
for-do: for z in us-central1-a us-central1-b; do gcloud compute instances create vm-$z --zone $z; done
bash-lc: bash -lc 'gcloud compute instances create lc-vm --zone us-central1-a'
aws-vault: aws-vault exec prod -- aws ec2 run-instances --image-id ami-1 --instance-type p4d.24xlarge
pnpm-exec: pnpm exec wrangler d1 create pe-db
npm-exec: npm exec -- wrangler d1 create ne-db
bun-x: bun x wrangler d1 create bx-db
xargs: echo a b | xargs -n1 -I{} gcloud compute instances create xa-{} --zone us-central1-a
gcloud-bg: gcloud compute instances create bgvm --zone us-central1-a &
gcloud-async: gcloud compute instances create as-vm --zone us-central1-a --async
gke-delete-async: gcloud container clusters create k1 --zone us-central1-a
gcloud container clusters delete k1 --zone us-central1-a --quiet --async
gcloud-zone-config: gcloud compute instances delete zc-vm --zone us-east1-b
heredoc-unterminated:
cat > run.sh <<'EOF'
gcloud compute instances create hd-vm --zone us-central1-a
EOF
heredoc-then-run:
cat > run.sh <<'EOF'
gcloud compute instances create hd2-vm --zone us-central1-a
EOF
bash run.sh

write-then-run-dotslash-sub.content: gcloud compute instances create ws2-vm --zone us-central1-a
